product: ABAC GRANT policies now cover Unity Gateway resource types (Beta)
tagline: Attribute based access control (ABAC) GRANT policies dynamically grant Unity Catalog privileges to securables whose governed tags match a condition.
what_it_does: Attribute based access control (ABAC) GRANT policies dynamically grant Unity Catalog privileges to securables whose governed tags match a condition. They now support model services, model provider services, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, and agent services, which are the resource types Unity Gateway governs. This lets you grant access to gateway resources by tag instead of one at a time.
